name: bqlang
description: GoogleSQL, BigQuery, and Jinja2/dbt language server and syntax support.

commands.title: BigQuery SQL: Refresh Estimated Query Cost

bqpls.path.description: Path to the bqpls language server executable. Leave empty to use the bundled or PATH executable.

bqpls.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the bqpls language server.

bqpls.defaultProject.description: Default GCP project ID used to qualify 1- or 2-part BigQuery table names. Overridden by [lsp].default_project in .bqfmt.toml.

bqpls.defaultDataset.description: Default BigQuery dataset ID used to qualify 1-part table names. Overridden by [lsp].default_dataset in .bqfmt.toml.

bqpls.schemaDirs.description: Directories containing static BigQuery table or schema JSON files. Relative paths resolve from the workspace root. Overridden by [lsp].schema_dirs in .bqfmt.toml.

bqpls.bigqueryApiEnabled.description: Enable asynchronous BigQuery REST v2 metadata fetching for table/column hover and completion (uses ADC / gcloud auth). Overridden by [lsp].bigquery_api_enabled in .bqfmt.toml.

bqpls.gcloudPath.description: Path to the gcloud CLI executable used for BigQuery authentication fallback (supports leading ~/). Leave empty to auto-detect from PATH and standard Google Cloud SDK directories. Overridden by [lsp].gcloud_path in .bqfmt.toml.

bqpls.cacheDir.description: Directory for persistent BigQuery metadata disk cache. Leave empty to use the OS user cache directory. Overridden by [lsp].cache_dir in .bqfmt.toml.

bqpls.cacheTtlSeconds.description: Disk metadata cache TTL in seconds (0 disables default disk cache reads). Overridden by [lsp].cache_ttl_seconds in .bqfmt.toml.

bqpls.projectCacheTtlSeconds.description: Per-project BigQuery metadata cache TTL extensions in seconds (project ID to seconds). Extends bqpls.cacheTtlSeconds and merges additively across User/Workspace settings and [lsp.project_cache_ttl_seconds] in .bqfmt.toml.

bqpls.diagnosticsEnabled.description: Enable syntax, semantic, and BigQuery diagnostics. Overridden by [lsp].diagnostics_enabled in .bqfmt.toml.

bqpls.requirePartitionFilterSeverity.description: Diagnostic severity when querying a table with requirePartitionFilter without filtering its partition column. Overridden by [lsp].require_partition_filter_severity in .bqfmt.toml.

bqpls.missingPartitionFilterSeverity.description: Diagnostic severity when querying a partitioned table without a sargable filter on its partition column in WHERE or JOIN. Overridden by [lsp].missing_partition_filter_severity in .bqfmt.toml.

bqpls.clusteringFilterSeverity.description: Diagnostic severity when querying a clustered table without filtering or joining on its leading clustering column. Overridden by [lsp].clustering_filter_severity in .bqfmt.toml.

bqpls.costEstimationEnabled.description: Enable estimated query cost reporting (BigQuery dry-run when bigqueryApiEnabled is true, with offline fallback from cached table sizes). Overridden by [lsp].cost_estimation_enabled in .bqfmt.toml.

bqpls.costCodeLensEnabled.description: Show estimated query bytes and cost as a CodeLens above each SQL statement. Overridden by [lsp].cost_codelens_enabled in .bqfmt.toml.

bqpls.costStatusBarEnabled.description: Show estimated query bytes and cost in the editor status bar. Overridden by [lsp].cost_status_bar_enabled in .bqfmt.toml.

bqpls.costHoverEnabled.description: Show humanized table size and full-table scan cost in table hover cards. Overridden by [lsp].cost_hover_enabled in .bqfmt.toml.

bqpls.costDiagnosticSeverity.description: Diagnostic severity when a query's estimated scan exceeds a configured cost threshold. Overridden by [lsp].cost_diagnostic_severity in .bqfmt.toml.

bqpls.costWarningThresholdBytes.description: Emit a diagnostic when a statement's estimated bytes processed exceeds this limit (0 disables byte threshold). Overridden by [lsp].cost_warning_threshold_bytes in .bqfmt.toml.

bqpls.costWarningThresholdUsd.description: Emit a diagnostic when a statement's estimated USD cost exceeds this limit (0 disables USD threshold). Overridden by [lsp].cost_warning_threshold_usd in .bqfmt.toml.

bqpls.costPricePerTibUsd.description: BigQuery on-demand query price in USD per TiB used for cost calculations. Overridden by [lsp].cost_price_per_tib_usd in .bqfmt.toml.

bqpls.costDryRunDebounceMs.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds after edits before triggering an asynchronous BigQuery dry-run (0 = immediate). Overridden by [lsp].cost_dry_run_debounce_ms in .bqfmt.toml.
